name: ASPCA Animal Poison Control Center (APCC) - 24/7 HOTLINE
neighborhoods: National hotline (use from anywhere, any hour)
notes: THE call for a suspected poisoning/toxin ingestion (lilies, meds, antifreeze, rodenticide, etc.) - staffed 24/7 by vet toxicologists who guide you AND your ER vet with a treatment plan. Lilies are deadly to cats even in tiny amounts. Then go to a 24hr ER (see Emergency tab). Verified 2026-08-26. Intake: Call 24/7/365. If a cat ate/contacted something toxic, call BEFORE inducing anything. Other channel: Consultation fee may apply (~$95; waived w/ HomeAgain-enrolled microchip)
